content: Two families of durable execution: replay/event-sourced (Temporal, Cadence) re-run the orchestrator folding a complete event history and require replay-determinism forever; checkpoint/state-snapshot (DBOS Transact, LangGraph checkpointers, most job runners) persist current state and resume by reading it. DBOS puts workflow state in the same transactional boundary as business data; Temporal holds it behind a service. For a short, linear, human-speed multi-role pipeline the checkpoint model fits: authoritative state in state columns + child tables, resume = SELECT the row, and an append-only event log for audit only (not folded for control flow). LangGraph shows pause-for-human and crash-recovery sharing one persistence layer.
